changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO staff_role_permissions (id, staff_role_id, permission_code, created_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), role.id, 'payout.reconcile', now() FROM staff_roles role WHERE role.code = 'FINANCE_OFFICER' ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_staff_role_permissions_role_code DO NOTHING;
